data.summary_en: DuoDiscover lets agent swarms co-discover optimization objectives and fast proxy yardsticks; fidelity tests remove drifting proxies, bypassing costly real evaluation. On CPU microarchitecture optimization (28 hours), authors claim it surpasses AlphaEvolve-based ArchAgent v2 and best human designs in 16.7 days, 1.65times gain over ArchAgent v2.
